searchText: Hi, can anyone point me to some research literature on the security model of optimistic rollups? have you checked the sites of such rollups if they point to any? I've done some searching of that nature (also Google, arxiv) and will do more, as well as asking on here. I've recently read that the Ethereum Foundation are working with Loopring on a zkEVM for the Loopring protocol. Is there any info on how this is progressing and when we might see it live? Is this the only zkEVM that EF has played a part in developing? I don't know if EF worked on it but zksync has deployed a prototype of their version to a testnet
